::: {#sol-draw-gradient}

Draw $\noise \sim \dNf{0, 1}$ first,
with no [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) involved,
and set $z = \mu + \sigma \noise$.
Then $z \sim \dNf{\mu, \sigma^2}$,
and $z$ is a differentiable function of $\mu$ and $\sigma$,
with $\partial z / \partial \mu = 1$ and $\partial z / \partial \sigma = \noise$.

:::
